title: Memory Care Statement Due Date, Grace Period and Late Fee Figures
content:
The business office bills the Memory Care Residency Agreement monthly rate in advance. The billing day, the grace period and the late fee components are set per tier as follows.

| Tier | Day of the month the monthly rate is billed | Grace period after posting (calendar days) | Late fee: flat component (USD) | Late fee: percentage component (percent of the past-due amount) | Past-due amount below which no late fee is assessed (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Memory Care Companion Suite with Essential Care | 1 | 10 | 85.00 | 1.5 | 150.00 |
| Memory Care Companion Suite with Enhanced Care | 1 | 10 | 85.00 | 1.5 | 150.00 |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Essential Care | 1 | 10 | 85.00 | 1.5 | 150.00 |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Enhanced Care | 1 | 10 | 85.00 | 1.5 | 150.00 |
| Memory Care Private Suite with Advanced Care | 1 | 10 | 85.00 | 1.5 | 150.00 |
| Memory Care Deluxe Suite with Advanced Care | 1 | 10 | 85.00 | 1.5 | 150.00 |

## Column notes

- The monthly rate is billed on the 1st day of the month, for the whole calendar month ahead.
- During the 10 calendar days of grace after posting, payment carries no late fee.
- The flat component is 85.00 and the percentage component is 1.5 percent; the late fee is built from these two figures.
- A past-due amount below 150.00 carries no late fee.
